name: Amulets
overview: Scripture warns against placing trust in amulets or vain ornaments as sources of protection or favor, emphasizing instead reliance on the LORD as refuge and fortress. The psalmist expresses hatred for those who trust in lying vanities, affirming trust only in God. Isaiah critiques the prideful and vain display of jewelry and charms among the people, indicating that such outward adornments will be removed by the Lord, highlighting their futility and the spiritual danger of trusting in them rather than in God.
